name: Identity, Settings, and Reference Data
purpose: Define stable reusable reference identities, lifecycle, exact candidate-matching boundaries, Site/Dispatch Location coupling, and typed settings ownership before domain LLDs consume them.

decisions.decision: Reference entities use immutable opaque SOMA IDs; names, email, addresses and external/account labels remain attributes/matching data rather than relational identity.
Exactly one Local User Profile authenticates the installation and remains distinct from reusable Contacts representing operational people/roles.
Contact identity survives Customer affiliation changes; the current affiliation is 0..1 and previous affiliations remain explicit history.
Reference reconciliation is deterministic, exact and scope-aware; ambiguity is returned for review and fuzzy similarity never authorizes identity mutation.
Dispatch Location is a customer-neutral reusable physical logistics reference; operation role is stored by the logistics operation, not the location master.

Site creation owns one atomic cross-module creation/link of its dedicated Dispatch Location; current address may derive from Site while historical logistics snapshots remain immutable under Inventory.
Reference lifecycle is archive/reactivate by default once history exists; archived records are historical-only for selection and archive is blocked by active stranding dependencies.
Settings use one typed namespaced registry but semantic ownership stays with the owning module; reads never persist defaults implicitly.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact normalized candidate-key implementation and storage/index strategy
exact setting names/types/default constants and UI grouping
authentication credential implementation delegated to HLD-13/LLD-12
